title: A post-validation handle still permits an untracked publishable UI file
observed: require_context now rejects dirty tracked files and new protected inventory, but site/verified-law/unlisted.js is untracked and outside the enumerated source maps. It is accepted with unchanged HEAD/code/known seals. publish_practice.py copies the entire site tree, so that extra disk source is publishable despite not being part of reviewed Git content.
probe_limit: A test-only already-valid-token fixture was used with the actual inventory function. No production token was minted and no site generation/publication occurred.
recommendation: Reject untracked nonignored source, with only the exact computed coverage K as an explicit validated exception. Also compare the entire publishable site disk inventory and bytes against HEAD so ignored publishable additions cannot evade the check.

title: Manifest, notes context and enrollment are not required to be committed HEAD blobs
observed: The new whole-delta helper uses subset allowlists. A HEAD containing only the registry change passes while exact M/N/E JSON files exist solely as untracked disk inputs. Current-source hash checks bind those bytes to registry hashes, but no later check binds them to HEAD regular blobs. The registry can therefore claim a registered context that a clean clone of that HEAD cannot reconstruct.
probe_limit: Actual Git-delta/current-reader helpers were exercised; the production registry remains empty and no complete native registration was run. Exact SHA authorization is not bypassed.
recommendation: Require all M/N/E paths to exist as regular HEAD blobs with exact raw bytes equal to the reviewed/current bindings. Validate the exact required post-content path set, retaining K only as a separately calculated optional output.

title: The public registered coverage API can return caller data as current native coverage
observed: coverage_snapshot checks selected counts through _coverage_value, then copies the caller coverage object into current_native_coverage. A caller-added field survives and the returned K can differ from context._expected_coverage. The actual artifact producer path recomputes correctly, and a later existing-K consumer check rejects the forged value; those do not bind the public API return itself.
probe_limit: An explicit setup mock stands in for the already-validated context to test the actual public API value predicate only. This does not obtain registry authorization, native PASS, admission or release.
recommendation: Only return registered coverage when the full supplied coverage, guide and payload match the actual producer values cached at mint. Keep the internal producer calculation path separate from public caller-input validation and unchanged legacy defaults.
